主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced results of its annual and special meeting of shareholders, where approximately 92% of Class A Limited Voting Shares voted in favor of an advisory vote approving the company’s approach to executive compensation. All eight nominees proposed for election to the board of directors by holders of Class A Shares and all eight nominees proposed for election to the board of directors by the holder of Class B Limited Voting Shares were elected. Management received proxies from Class A Shareholders for the election of eight directors, with high vote percentages for each nominee. Additionally, the holder of Class B Shares provided a proxy to vote all 85,120 Class B Shares for each of the eight directors nominated by this shareholder class. Brookfield Asset Management Inc. is a leading global alternative asset manager with approximately US$285 billion in assets under management.
